name: Test Runner
description: Run your workspace's tests from the sidebar, re-run the related ones when an agent finishes, and send failures back to the agent. Vitest, Jest, Playwright, Cypress, Gradle, Maven and pytest are found on their own, monorepos included; if your setup is not, the README has a prompt that has your agent write .orca-test-runner.json at the repository root.

screenshots.alt: A failing test in the panel and the one-line prompt Test Runner types into the agent
screenshots.caption: Failures go back to the agent as one line

screenshots.caption: Most repositories need no setup; for the rest, ask your agent

commands.title: Test Runner: Run tests in this workspace

settings.title: Run tests when an agent finishes
settings.description: Re-runs tests in a workspace after one of its agents finishes a turn that changed files. Browser tests (Playwright, Cypress) are left out unless .orca-test-runner.json opts them in.

settings.title: What runs after an agent finishes
settings.description: Related: only tests that import the changed files (Vitest and Jest; other runners run their whole suite when their folder changed). All: every test.

settings.title: Re-run failures once to catch flaky tests
settings.description: A test that fails and then passes is marked flaky and is not sent to the agent.

settings.title: Send new failures back to the agent automatically
settings.description: After an automatic run, failures the agent caused are typed into that agent, which fixes them and triggers the next run.

settings.title: Notify after automatic runs
settings.description: Shows a desktop notification when an automatic run fails, or passes again after failing.

settings.title: Agent to start
settings.description: Started with the failure when you ask for a fix and the workspace has no agent.
